newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B index ends up at year-high.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B index ends up at year-high.

text.p: The Shanghai B share index ended up at a year-high on Tuesday with domestic investors buying Pudong real estate after A shares reversed early losses, brokers said.
The B index rose 0.756 points or 1.02 percent to 74.895 points on volume of 13.95 million shares worth $7.9 million, compared with $8.8 million on Monday.
Domestic investors entered the market in the afternoon encouraged by gains on the A share market, pushing the index to a year high, but investors largely remained sidelined, brokers said.
Shanghai Waigaoqiao Free Trade Zone Development gained $0.016 or 3.34 percent to $0.494 on volume of 678,300 shares.

Another Pudong stock, Shanghai Lujiazui Finance & Trade Zone Development, the most actively traded counter, also erased early losses, up $0.002 or 0.19 percent to $1.032 on volume of 1.3 million shares.

"Pudong is waiting to celebrate its seventh anniversary (since its establishment in 1990 as Shanghai's premier economic develoment zone) and that was used by some domestic investors as an excuse to boost the market," one broker said.
"But follow-up buying was limited on un-released results," he said.
The market has strengthened recently on improved sentiment and further gains are expected in the short term with rotation buying, brokers said.
Of 43 B shares, 42 traded, with 20 up, nine flat and 13 down.
Shanghai Tyre & Rubber was the star on expectations of improved results in 1996, up $0.026 or 5.43 percent to $0.504 on volume of 687,100 shares.
The Shanghai A share index ended up after a technical correction in the morning, as market sentiment remained bullish, brokers said.

The index gained 8.298 points or 0.60 percent to 1,389.752 points on volume of 938.2 million shares worth 11.4 billion yuan. The SSE30 index added 14.810 points or 0.41 percent to 3,596.396 points. Yunnan Malong Chemicals & Construction was the star on institutional buying, soaring 1.35 yuan or 10.02 percent to 14.81 yuan on volume of 2.4 million shares.
